title: RAW UNREVIEWED: f22r cups and bead spikes are co-present organs or stages of one organ
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. The admitted f22r drawing visibly juxtaposes blue cup-like structures and red bead-like spikes. Freeze their exact attachments from the existing image and ask a dated illustrated primary to own one named plant with an explicit relation between two unlike organs, rather than assigning either color a name. An exploratory complete f22r reading could then distinguish simultaneously different parts from one organ at successive stages. GDT1087 leaves MORUS undecidable and GDT765 treats two local fields as parallel; neither binds the visible structures to words. No source entry or target lexeme is currently bound; unreviewed, not selected or tested.

design.mechanism: Two illustrated structures carry either two part roles or a temporal transformation under one subject
design.unit: the complete admitted f22r plant image and its permitted text owner
design.contrast: source-written simultaneous part relation versus maturation sequence versus unrelated decorative structures
design.prediction: A fixed complete reading must preserve both visible structures, their shared plant owner, and the source relation; a sequence requires explicit stage ordering while a part list requires two persistent organs. No reading wins on image color alone.
